    STATEMENT: GHOST shall derive traceable memory vector entries from durable MemoryRecords, persist them in a dedicated memory vector store, retrieve current-history semantic candidates, perform deterministic metadata lookups, score parent records and chunks, build a MemoryContextPack, and hand selected evidence to runtime compression and synthesis.

    GHOST-MEM-IR-BOUNDARY
    1.6. Ingestion and Retrieval Boundary
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-BOUNDARY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: This document shall own memory vector-entry construction, memory vector persistence, ingestion orchestration, semantic vector search, deterministic index lookup, scoring, candidate selection, MemoryContextPack construction, and SuperPrompt memory-artifact write-back.

    It shall not own document retrieval, document A3/A4, durable MemoryRecord body changes, or final user-answer generation.

    3. 3. Memory Vector Entry Model

    STATEMENT: MemoryChunker creates one discovery handle and zero or more question and answer blocks for each MemoryRecord.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-ENTRY-ROLES
    3.1. Vector Entry Roles

    RELATIONS (Parent):

    3.4. Answer Entries
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ANSWER-BLOCKS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):

    STATEMENT: MemoryChunker shall create ordered answer entries from output_text, beginning with block_id 0001 and position one.

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-EMPTY-ENTRY-FILTER

    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ENTRY-ROLES Vector Entry Roles

    3.7. Vector Parent Traceability
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ID-TRACEABILITY
    STATUS: Draft

    3.8. Record Handle Project Text
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-PROJECT
    STATUS: Draft

    3.9. Record Handle Automatic Keywords
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-YAKE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):

    STATEMENT: The current record-handle embedded text shall include YAKE_KEYWORDS derived from automatic keywords.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-QUESTION
    3.10. Record Handle Question Anchor
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-QUESTION
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ONE-HANDLE One Record Handle
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-QUESTION-ANCHOR-TRUNCATE Question Anchor Truncation
    STATEMENT: The current record-handle embedded text shall include a QUESTION_ANCHOR derived from the first question block and bounded by question_anchor_tokens.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-NO-TAG-TEXT
    3.11. Current Handle Text Exclusions
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-NO-TAG-TEXT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):

    STATEMENT: The current record-handle embedded text shall not include tag or user_keywords, although those values may remain present in vector metadata.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-ENTRY-METADATA

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ENTRY-METADATA
    STATUS: Draft

    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-METADATA-SNAPSHOT Vector Metadata Snapshot
    STATEMENT: Each vector entry shall carry current file and record identifiers, paired filenames, parent_id, role, block identity and position, character offsets, approximate token count, tag, project, source, creation time, hashes, keyword text, embedded-file snapshot text, chunking configuration version, and ingestion hash.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-METADATA-SNAPSHOT
    3.13. Vector Metadata Snapshot
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-METADATA-SNAPSHOT

    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-LIVE-METADATA-OVERLAY Live Metadata during Retrieval
    STATEMENT: Vector metadata shall represent values at ingestion time and shall remain derivative rather than current metadata authority.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-LIVE-METADATA-OVERLAY
    3.14. Live Metadata during Retrieval
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-LIVE-METADATA-OVERLAY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-METADATA-SNAPSHOT Vector Metadata Snapshot
    STATEMENT: When live MemoryRecords are available, retrieval scoring and candidate enrichment shall overlay live record metadata onto vector-derived metadata.

    4. 4. Memory Chunking and Ingestion Hash

    STATEMENT: The current chunker uses approximate whitespace-token counts and paragraph/sentence-aware grouping rather than a provider tokenizer.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG
    4.1. Current Chunker Configuration
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-TOKEN-APPROX Approximate Token Counting
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-PARAGRAPH-UNITS Paragraph Unit Selection
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-SENTENCE-UNITS Oversized Paragraph Sentence Units
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-HARD-SPLIT Oversized Unit Hard Split
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-BLOCK-TARGET Target Block Completion
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-BLOCK-OFFSETS Block Offsets
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNK-CONFIG-JSON-DIRECTION Chunker JSON Migration Direction
    STATEMENT: MemoryChunker shall maintain current defaults config_version memory_chunker_001, target_tokens 500, max_tokens 800, and question_anchor_tokens 220, with optional constructor overrides.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-TOKEN-APPROX
    4.2. Approximate Token Counting
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-TOKEN-APPROX
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: Current MemoryChunker token counts shall be the number of non-whitespace word matches and shall not be described as exact provider-token counts.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-PARAGRAPH-UNITS
    4.3. Paragraph Unit Selection
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-PARAGRAPH-UNITS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: Paragraphs not exceeding max_tokens shall be used as semantic units.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-SENTENCE-UNITS
    4.4. Oversized Paragraph Sentence Units
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-SENTENCE-UNITS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: An oversized paragraph shall be split into current sentence-like units based on punctuation or line endings.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-HARD-SPLIT
    4.5. Oversized Unit Hard Split
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-HARD-SPLIT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: A semantic unit exceeding max_tokens shall be hard-split by non-whitespace word groups of at most max_tokens approximate tokens.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-BLOCK-TARGET
    4.6. Target Block Completion
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-BLOCK-TARGET
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: Current units shall accumulate until target_tokens is reached or the next unit would exceed max_tokens.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-BLOCK-OFFSETS
    4.7. Block Offsets
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-BLOCK-OFFSETS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: Every question or answer block shall retain start_offset and end_offset relative to its source side.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-QUESTION-ANCHOR-TRUNCATE
    4.8. Question Anchor Truncation
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-QUESTION-ANCHOR-TRUNCATE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-HANDLE-QUESTION Record Handle Question Anchor
    STATEMENT: Question-anchor truncation shall retain the first configured number of whitespace-delimited words.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGESTION-HASH
    4.9. Ingestion Hash
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGESTION-HASH
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-INGESTION-HASH-NOT-TRUTH Ingestion Hash Status
    STATEMENT: MemoryChunker shall compute SHA-256 over a deterministic JSON payload describing file_id, record_id, input/output hashes, tag, automatic/user keywords, active project, and chunking configuration version.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGESTION-HASH-NOT-TRUTH
    4.10. Ingestion Hash Status
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGESTION-HASH-NOT-TRUTH
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-INGESTION-HASH Ingestion Hash
    STATEMENT: The ingestion hash shall identify the derivative ingestion representation and shall not replace input_hash, output_hash, record_id, or file_id.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNK-CONFIG-JSON-DIRECTION
    4.11. Chunker JSON Migration Direction
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNK-CONFIG-JSON-DIRECTION
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CHUNKER-CONFIG Current Chunker Configuration
    STATEMENT: Memory chunk sizes, anchor limit, and chunker version are operational tuning values and shall migrate to validated versioned JSON configuration before being claimed as centrally configured.

    5. 5. Dedicated Memory Vector Store

    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore owns persistent memory embeddings and record/file-level vector replacement or deletion.

    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-EMPTY Empty Replacement Entry Set
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DOCUMENTS Embedded Documents
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-METADATA-SANITIZE Metadata Sanitization
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-EMBED Document Embedding

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DELETE-FILE Delete History Vectors

    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore shall create its persistence directory and open or create one named Chroma collection.

    5.2. Vector Store Non-Authority
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-NO-TRUTH
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):

    GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-ID
    5.3. Record Replacement Identifier Validation
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-ID
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: replace_record_entries shall reject an empty record_id.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-DELETE-FIRST
    5.4. Current Record Replacement Order
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-DELETE-FIRST
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-REPLACEMENT-ATOMICITY Current Replacement Transaction Boundary
    STATEMENT: Current record replacement shall count and delete all existing vectors for record_id before embedding and adding the new entry set.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-EMPTY
    5.5. Empty Replacement Entry Set
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-EMPTY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: When replacement receives no entries, it shall leave the record with zero vectors and return a successful zero-write report after deleting prior vectors.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DOCUMENTS
    5.6. Embedded Documents
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DOCUMENTS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: The memory vector collection shall persist the vector entry document text together with embeddings and sanitized metadata.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-METADATA-SANITIZE
    5.7. Metadata Sanitization
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-METADATA-SANITIZE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: Vector metadata shall be converted to Chroma-compatible scalar values; non-scalar values shall be JSON-serialized and None shall become an empty string.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-EMBED
    5.8. Document Embedding
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-EMBED
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore shall obtain one embedding per vector-entry document through its configured embedder and normalize returned vectors to lists of floats.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-ADD
    5.9. Vector Add Contract
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-ADD
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: After prior record vectors are deleted, current replacement shall add aligned IDs, documents, embeddings, and metadata to the collection.

    5.10. Replacement Report
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-REPLACE-REPORT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: Record replacement shall report success, record_id, deleted prior vector count, vectors written, resulting record vector count, collection name, and persistence directory.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-QUERY-EMPTY
    5.11. Empty Store Query
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-QUERY-EMPTY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore.query shall return an empty hit list when query_text is empty after trimming.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-QUERY
    5.12. Store Query Contract
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-QUERY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore.query shall embed query_text, query the collection with optional sanitized flat metadata filter, and return ordered flat hits containing id, document, metadata, distance, and one-based rank.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DELETE-RECORD
    5.13. Delete Record Vectors
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DELETE-RECORD
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore.delete_record shall delete vectors by record_id and report deleted and remaining counts.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DELETE-FILE
    5.14. Delete History Vectors
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-DELETE-FILE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: MemoryVectorStore.delete_file shall delete vectors by file_id and report deleted and remaining file-level counts.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-COUNT-SAFE
    5.15. Vector Count Failure Behavior
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-COUNT-SAFE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-PERSISTENT Persistent Chroma Store
    STATEMENT: Current count_record and count_file helpers shall return zero when collection counting raises an exception.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-REPLACEMENT-ATOMICITY
    5.16. Current Replacement Transaction Boundary
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-STORE-REPLACEMENT-ATOMICITY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-REPLACE-DELETE-FIRST Current Record Replacement Order
    STATEMENT: Current delete-then-add replacement shall not be described as one atomic storage transaction; durable MemoryRecord truth shall provide failure isolation when vector replacement is interrupted.

    6. 6. Memory Ingestion Orchestration

    STATEMENT: MemoryIngestionManager coordinates record lookup, vector-entry construction, replacement, reporting, bulk ingestion, and optional daemon-thread scheduling.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-DEPS
    6.1. Ingestion Dependencies
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-DEPS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: MemoryIngestionManager shall receive the active MemoryManager, MemoryChunker, and MemoryVectorStore.

    6.2. Ingest Record Identifier Validation
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ID
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: ingest_record shall return an unsuccessful result when record_id is empty.

    6.3. Live Record Lookup
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-LOOKUP
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: ingest_record shall resolve record_id from the active MemoryManager.records list and shall report unsuccessful status when not found.

    6.4. Vector Entry Construction
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-BUILD
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: For a found record, ingestion shall call MemoryChunker.build_vector_entries with current file_id and paired filenames.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ROLE-COUNTS
    6.5. Ingestion Role Counts
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ROLE-COUNTS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Ingestion shall count returned entries by metadata role for diagnostics and result reporting.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-REPLACE
    6.6. Record Vector Replacement
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-REPLACE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-IDEMPOTENT-REPRESENTATION Record-Level Re-Ingestion Idempotency
    STATEMENT: Ingestion shall replace all vectors for the record_id using the newly generated entry set.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-RESULT
    6.7. Ingestion Result Enrichment
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-RESULT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: The ingestion result shall include role counts, current file_id, and active .ragmem filename in addition to store replacement data.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-EXCEPTION
    6.8. Ingestion Exception Handling
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-EXCEPTION
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: An exception during vector-entry construction or store replacement shall return an unsuccessful record-level result and shall not modify durable MemoryRecord files.

    6.9. Loaded History Bulk Ingestion
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ALL
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ALL-STATUS Bulk Ingestion Success Status
    STATEMENT: ingest_all shall iterate the current active MemoryManager record list in order, invoke ingest_record for each record, and report total, success, failure, and individual results.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ALL-STATUS
    6.10. Bulk Ingestion Success Status
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ALL-STATUS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-ALL Loaded History Bulk Ingestion
    STATEMENT: The bulk ingestion success field shall be true only when failure_count is zero.

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-CLEANUP Async Active-Set Cleanup

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-NO-DURABLE-QUEUE No Durable Ingestion Queue Claim

    6.12. Duplicate Async Suppression
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-DUPLICATE
    STATUS: Draft

    6.13. Async Active-Set Cleanup
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-CLEANUP
    STATUS: Draft

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-SCHEDULE Asynchronous Record Ingestion
    STATEMENT: The asynchronous worker shall remove record_id from the active set in a finally block.

    6.14. Optional Streamlit Thread Context
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-STREAMLIT-CONTEXT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-SCHEDULE Asynchronous Record Ingestion
    STATEMENT: When available, current scheduling shall attach the active Streamlit script context to the ingestion thread; absence of that support shall not block thread start.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-NO-DURABLE-QUEUE
    6.15. No Durable Ingestion Queue Claim
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-NO-DURABLE-QUEUE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ASYNC-SCHEDULE Asynchronous Record Ingestion
    STATEMENT: The current daemon-thread scheduler shall not be described as a durable queue, retry service, or cross-process ingestion coordinator.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-IDEMPOTENT-REPRESENTATION
    6.16. Record-Level Re-Ingestion Idempotency
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-IDEMPOTENT-REPRESENTATION
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-REPLACE Record Vector Replacement
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-IDEMPOTENT AC: Record Re-Ingestion
    STATEMENT: Re-ingesting a record shall replace its prior record_id vectors rather than intentionally append duplicate representations.

    7. 7. Memory Retrieval Input and Routing Preconditions

    STATEMENT: MemoryRetriever receives the active SuperPrompt, current MemoryManager, dedicated vector store, SQLite path, and runtime configuration.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-RETRIEVER-DEPS
    7.1. MemoryRetriever Dependencies

    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):

    RELATIONS (Child):

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ENABLED Memory Retrieval Enable Switch
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-MEMORY-PERMISSION PreProcessing Memory Permission
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-MISSING-FILE-ID Missing Active file_id
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-QUERY-PRIMARY Primary Memory Query
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-EMPTY-QUERY Empty Query Result
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-DIRECT-KEY-INPUT Direct Recall Key Input
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-LATEST-BRIEF Latest Eligible ActiveBrief Snapshot

    8. 8. Semantic Memory Vector Pass

    STATEMENT: The semantic pass uses one active-history query to produce raw vector hits, parent-record scores, semantic chunks, and episodic candidates.

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: When semantic_memory_chunks.enabled is false, the semantic pass shall return empty raw hits, scored hits, parent scores, semantic chunks, and semantic episodic candidates.

    RELATIONS (Parent):

    RELATIONS (Child):

    Cross-history semantic fallback shall be treated as non-conforming unless separately approved.

    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-K-NOT-CLOCK
    STATUS: Draft

    STATEMENT: Current recency adds a bounded episode-distance signal for Green candidates while Gold bypasses normal decay.

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-EPISODIC-WEIGHTS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Current Green episodic scoring shall use configured semantic and recency weights whose baselines are 0.75 and 0.25.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-WEIGHT-NORMALIZATION

    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Semantic and recency weights shall be clamped non-negative and normalized to sum one; when their total is non-positive, the effective weights shall become 1.0 semantic and 0.0 recency.

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-RECENCY AC: Episode Recency
    STATEMENT: Current recency score shall use 2 raised to negative k divided by half_life_k; the current episodic baseline half-life is 10 records.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-RECENCY-MISSING

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-RECENCY-MISSING
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Missing, invalid, NaN, or infinite episode distance shall produce recency score 1.0 so otherwise relevant memory is not discarded solely by absent metadata.

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-RECENCY-NEGATIVE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Negative episode distance shall be treated as zero.

    10.7. Invalid Half-Life Fallback
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-RECENCY-HALF-LIFE-FALLBACK
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Invalid, non-positive, NaN, or infinite half-life shall use the current fallback 10.0.

    STATUS: Draft

    16. 16. Error Handling, Security, and Quality Boundaries

    STATEMENT: Memory retrieval must fail or empty safely without fabricating context or weakening history scope.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-FABRICATED-HIT
    16.1. No Fabricated Vector Hit
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-FABRICATED-HIT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Missing vector collection, embedder, SQLite row, .ragmem body, or live record shall produce missing/empty candidate data rather than invented content.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-RETRIEVAL-FAIL-TRUTH
    16.2. Retrieval Failure and Durable Truth
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-RETRIEVAL-FAIL-TRUTH
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: A memory retrieval failure shall not modify .ragmem, .ragmeta.json, SQLite record truth, or stored memory vectors.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-FAIL-TRUTH
    16.3. Ingestion Failure and Durable Truth
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-FAIL-TRUTH
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    RELATIONS (Child):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-ASYNC-FAIL AC: Ingestion Failure Isolation
    STATEMENT: A memory ingestion failure shall leave the durable MemoryRecord body and current metadata intact.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-CROSS-HISTORY-AUTO
    16.4. No Unapproved Automatic Cross-History Retrieval
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-CROSS-HISTORY-AUTO
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Automatic working, Gold, semantic parent, and semantic chunk retrieval shall remain active-history scoped; only exact Direct Recall may cross histories in the current design.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-SECRET
    16.5. No Secret Vector Metadata
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-SECRET
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Memory vector documents and metadata shall not intentionally include provider API keys or browser credentials.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-PUBLIC-LOG
    16.6. Public Retrieval Logging
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-PUBLIC-LOG
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Public logs shall report compact counts and statuses and shall not expose complete memory bodies, query embeddings, or vector values by default.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-CONFIDENTIAL-LOG
    16.7. Confidential Retrieval Diagnostics
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-CONFIDENTIAL-LOG
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Complete raw hits, candidates, scoring snapshots, and pack payloads shall remain behind explicitly enabled confidential developer logging.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-SCORE-REPRODUCIBILITY

    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-SCORE-REPRODUCIBILITY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Diagnostics shall preserve effective scoring policy, candidate counts, query text, and active file identity sufficiently to reproduce selection decisions without exposing credentials.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-DETERMINISTIC-TESTS
    16.9. Deterministic Retrieval Testability
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-DETERMINISTIC-TESTS
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Vector ID generation, chunk splitting, metadata sanitation, distance conversion, role aggregation, recency decay, tag filtering, deterministic lookups, candidate merge, and pack projection shall be independently testable.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-DOC-A3
    16.10. No Memory-to-Document A3 Claim
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-NO-DOC-A3

    RELATIONS (Parent):

    17. 17. Traceability and Acceptance Criteria

    STATEMENT: These criteria verify derivative memory ingestion, retrieval, candidate selection, and SuperPrompt handoff.

    • GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SYNC AC: Requirement-Code Synchronization
    STATEMENT: MemoryChunker, MemoryIngestionManager, MemoryVectorStore, MemoryRetriever, MemoryIndexLookup, MemoryScorer, and MemoryContextPack shall map to the deepest applicable UIDs in this document.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-SIBLING-BOUNDARY
    17.2. Sibling Ownership Boundary
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-SIBLING-BOUNDARY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROOT Memory Ingestion and Retrieval Scope
    STATEMENT: Durable recording/files shall remain owned by 51; ActiveBrief algorithms, runtime compression, and synthesis shall remain owned by 53.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-ENTRIES
    17.3. AC: Vector Entry Roles
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-ENTRIES
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ENTRY-ROLES Vector Entry Roles
    STATEMENT: Given one non-empty MemoryRecord, ingestion shall create one non-empty record handle and the expected ordered non-empty question and answer entries with stable traceable IDs.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-IDEMPOTENT
    17.4. AC: Record Re-Ingestion
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-IDEMPOTENT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-IDEMPOTENT-REPRESENTATION Record-Level Re-Ingestion Idempotency
    STATEMENT: Re-ingesting the same record_id shall replace prior vectors and shall not increase the number of duplicate IDs for that record.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-ASYNC-FAIL
    17.5. AC: Ingestion Failure Isolation
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-ASYNC-FAIL
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-INGEST-FAIL-TRUTH Ingestion Failure and Durable Truth
    STATEMENT: If vector embedding or replacement fails, the corresponding .ragmem block and metadata shall remain available as durable truth.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-WORKING
    17.6. AC: Working Memory
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-WORKING
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-WORKING-LATEST Working Memory Ordering and Limit
    STATEMENT: Given an active history with more records than max_pairs, working lookup shall return only the latest configured non-excluded records from that history.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-DIRECT
    17.7. AC: Exact Direct Recall
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-DIRECT
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-DIRECT-PRIORITY Direct Recall Result Priority
    STATEMENT: Given the same Direct Recall Key in multiple histories, lookup shall return at most one non-excluded result using tag priority and recency ordering.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-PARENT-SCORE
    17.8. AC: Parent Role Scoring
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-PARENT-SCORE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-ROLE-MAX Current Per-Role Aggregation
    STATEMENT: Given multiple hits for one parent and role, the current parent role score shall equal the maximum role hit and final semantic score shall apply the configured QA/Q/A weights.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-RECENCY
    17.9. AC: Episode Recency
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-RECENCY
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-RECENCY-HALF-LIFE Episode-Distance Half-Life
    STATEMENT: For Green records at k zero and k equal to half-life, recency scores shall be 1.0 and 0.5 before semantic/recency weighted combination.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-GOLD
    17.10. AC: Gold Priority and Deduplication
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-GOLD
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-EPISODIC-DEDUPE Episodic Record Deduplication
    STATEMENT: A Gold record also selected semantically shall appear once in final episodic candidates and shall retain Gold-first source priority.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SEMANTIC
    17.11. AC: Semantic Chunk Roles
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SEMANTIC
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-SEMANTIC-ROLES Semantic Chunk Evidence Roles
    STATEMENT: Final semantic memory chunks shall contain question/answer evidence only and shall exclude record_handle entries.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SCOPE
    17.12. AC: Automatic History Scope
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SCOPE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-FILTER-FAILURE Filtered Query Failure Integrity
    STATEMENT: Automatic semantic and deterministic retrieval shall not return a record from another history solely because the active-file filter failed.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-PACK
    17.13. AC: MemoryContextPack
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-PACK
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-PACK-COUNTS Candidate Counts
    STATEMENT: After one successful memory retrieval, the SuperPrompt shall contain a MemoryContextPack whose candidate counts match its actual lists and optional Direct Recall/context fields.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SEPARATE
    17.14. AC: Document Artifact Separation
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SEPARATE
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-SP-NO-DOCUMENT-OVERWRITE Document Artifact Preservation
    STATEMENT: Running memory retrieval shall leave document chunk objects, stage views, and S_CTX_MD unchanged.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-PERMISSION
    17.15. AC: Memory Context Permission
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-PERMISSION
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-MEMORY-PERMISSION PreProcessing Memory Permission
    STATEMENT: When PreProcessing sets allow_memory_context false, the final SuperPrompt shall not receive synthesized memory context for that request.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-CONFIG
    17.16. AC: Configuration Consumption Truth
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-CONFIG
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CONFIG-ROOT Memory Retrieval Configuration
    STATEMENT: Changing an unconsumed JSON field shall not be represented as changing runtime behavior; changing a consumed field shall be observable in selection or diagnostics.
    GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SYNC
    17.17. AC: Requirement-Code Synchronization
    UID: GHOST-MEM-IR-AC-SYNC
    STATUS: Draft
    RELATIONS (Parent):
    • GHOST-MEM-IR-CODE-OWNERSHIP Ingestion and Retrieval Code Ownership
    STATEMENT: A memory ingestion/retrieval baseline shall not be accepted when vector identity, history scope, scoring equations, tag policy, candidate roles, pack semantics, or configuration authority contradicts this document.
